semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The foundation facilitates collaboration and innovation in the semiconductor sector through a regional consortium.
summary: The Okayama Prefecture Industrial Promotion Foundation advances semiconductor technology by fostering collaboration among local manufacturing firms and research institutions through the 'Okayama Semiconductor-Related Consortium.' This initiative aims to address industry challenges and create new business opportunities within the semiconductor sector.
capabilities: Promoting information sharing among consortium members
Supporting regional partnerships in semiconductor innovation

regional_presence.Japan: The foundation is based in Okayama Prefecture and focuses on regional partnerships and innovation within Japan.
